name: C2R1 geometry / assembly / interference
why: Native C2R1 candidate geometry, J2 mate architecture and hard-interference gate.

name: Tolerance chain + P006 service drive
why: H9/h9 and fastener-position stacks are defined; T03 passes its CAD scope after the P006 candidate and full C2R1+P006 assembly verification pass. P006 production material remains a separate product-release hold.

name: Seal media + compound + compression/leak qualification
why: FKM 75A is the preferred bounded-BOF candidate with FFKM fallback; local temperature/media/compound/force/leak evidence remains.

name: M2.5 preload / local flange / torque process
why: 200–300 N/screw study window passes thread/contact screening. Release still requires actual seal load, torque–clamp calibration and local contact evidence.

name: Thermal preload / galling / service cycles
why: Matched stainless CTE is favorable; released finish/lubrication and repeated-service qualification remain.

name: P007 final static + buckling refresh
why: Historical results remain background evidence only; final C2R1 geometry/preload needs one release refresh.

name: BOM property projection / normalization
why: Project controlled identity/text properties into native files, then rerun BOM reconciliation. OPEN materials remain OPEN.

name: TPD production drawings
why: Release needs native V3 + release-semantic lint + visual approval bound to PDF hashes. A generated PDF alone is not release evidence.

name: P015/B001 freeze -> FEMM -> bench
why: Final electromagnetic release is fail-closed until production magnet/coil inputs, FEMM and bench evidence exist.

name: Atomic P003/P007 promotion
why: Promotion remains blocked until the production-release dependency set closes and the technical filter contains no hard holds.
